analogy.rationale: Direct adenylyl cyclase activation raises cAMP, but the transcriptional footprint in these cell lines is typically modest and largely overlaps with other cAMP-elevating classes such as guanylate cyclase activators and phosphodiesterase inhibitors. GPCR agonists/antagonists that couple to Gs/Gi can partially mimic or oppose the cAMP signal, though their effects depend on receptor expression.
